summary: Preserve fractional native AAC composition origins and exact seek sample boundaries

examples: CTTS -5 on a192kHz media clock keeps3071 native samples instead of3070 and labels the first at0ns rather than15.625us.
Seek to native source1024 loses a sample (2047 rather than2048 remain); native source3071 can disappear entirely.
Positive fractional origins change packet timestamps and can skip the requested first sample.

tests_run: cargo test --locked --offline --no-default-features --features player --test mp4_aac_fractional_origin (initial/expanded, corrected after, isolated final before)
cargo clean -p fvid (only owned target; invalidate differing-source snapshot artifacts)
